relationships.title: Nvidia equity in Mistral AI (Series C participation)
relationships.insight_template: Nvidia owns an undisclosed {counterparty} stake; its own cloud runs on Nvidia systems, so the stake and those hardware sales rest on the same customer.
relationships.definition: Nvidia is an existing shareholder in Mistral AI and took part in its Series C round of EUR 1.7 billion at an EUR 11.7 billion post-money valuation, announced on 9 September 2025 and led by ASML. Neither side states how much Nvidia put in. Mistral Compute, the company's own cloud, is built on Nvidia reference architectures.

reconciliation.nvidia_side: No disclosure found as of 2026-11-23. No Nvidia release or filing names the Mistral investment (R3 crawl).
reconciliation.counterparty_side: Mistral's release lists NVIDIA among existing investors participating in the Series C (ev_90026); round size and valuation in EUR (ev_90027).

credit.wwr_reason: Equity value and Mistral's ability to keep buying Nvidia based compute both fall if demand for open weight models weakens; exposure does not grow with distress.

first_order.trigger: Mistral raises its next round at a lower valuation
first_order.mechanism: Nvidia's undisclosed Mistral stake is marked down with no recovery other than resale
first_order.text: If Mistral prices its next round lower, Nvidia books a loss on a stake whose cost it has never disclosed.

first_order.trigger: Mistral Compute cannot fill its capacity
first_order.mechanism: Mistral Compute orders fewer Nvidia systems
first_order.text: If Mistral Compute cannot sell its capacity, Mistral orders fewer Nvidia systems at the same time its equity loses value.

second_order.trigger: Nvidia stops following on in Mistral rounds
second_order.mechanism: Co-investors such as ASML read Nvidia's absence as a signal on Mistral's compute access
second_order.text: Mistral's investors, including lead ASML, priced the Series C with Nvidia in the syndicate, so a visible Nvidia exit would raise Mistral's cost of capital.

second_order.trigger: Mistral Compute buys Nvidia hardware with round proceeds
second_order.mechanism: Equity Nvidia helped raise returns to Nvidia as system revenue
second_order.text: Part of the money Mistral raised with Nvidia's participation funds Mistral Compute, built on Nvidia reference designs, so some Nvidia revenue rests on its own capital.

depth2_links.description: Led the Mistral Series C of EUR 1.7 billion (ev_90028).

relationships.notes: Round size is EUR 1.7 billion (ev_90027); not converted to USD because no FX rate from an allowed source is on file. Compute tie: 'As a premier NVIDIA partner, Mistral Compute will offer the latest NVIDIA reference architectures' (ev_90067, 2025-06-11). Mistral's Series D (EUR 3 billion, led by Samsung Electronics, cached) does not name NVIDIA. Earlier 2023 and 2024 Nvidia participation reported by Bloomberg (Dec 2023) is not quoted: needs quote.

relationships.title: Nvidia equity investment in Safe Superintelligence
relationships.insight_template: Nvidia made a substantial undisclosed investment in {counterparty} paired with Vera Rubin access, so the money likely returns as compute spending.
relationships.definition: On 27 July 2026 Nvidia and SSI announced a long term partnership and Nvidia said it had made an investment in SSI. The release pairs the investment with access to Nvidia's Vera Rubin platform to raise SSI's compute by an order of magnitude. No amount, price or share class is stated.

reconciliation.nvidia_side: Nvidia release states 'NVIDIA has additionally made an investment in SSI' and calls it substantial (ev_30059, ev_30060).
reconciliation.counterparty_side: No disclosure found as of 2026-11-23. SSI's own site (ssi.inc) carries no release; the joint release appears only on Nvidia's newsroom.

credit.wwr_reason: SSI has no disclosed revenue; the stake's value depends on research progress and on AI funding conditions that also drive Nvidia demand.

first_order.trigger: SSI's research does not produce a product or new funding
first_order.mechanism: The undisclosed SSI stake loses value with no collateral
first_order.text: If SSI cannot raise again, Nvidia's substantial stake in SSI could be written down without any recovery.

first_order.trigger: SSI draws its funding to buy compute
first_order.mechanism: Investment cash returns to Nvidia as Vera Rubin system or cloud purchases
first_order.text: SSI said Nvidia's money plus Vera Rubin access will scale its compute, so part of the investment likely returns to Nvidia as revenue.

second_order.trigger: Other investors assess SSI's funding
second_order.mechanism: Nvidia calls its SSI investment substantial but discloses no amount
second_order.text: Nvidia calls its SSI stake substantial but gives no amount, so no one outside can tell how much of SSI's funding rests on Nvidia.

second_order.trigger: Nvidia counts SSI compute purchases in data center revenue
second_order.mechanism: Revenue partly funded by Nvidia equity
second_order.text: Any SSI purchases of Vera Rubin capacity would be revenue Nvidia partly financed through its own SSI investment.

relationships.notes: Bloomberg (2026-07-27) reported, citing people familiar, that Nvidia committed $5 billion; single tier 2 source, not cached (HTTP 403): needs quote, not displayed. An April 2025 SSI round with reported Nvidia participation (CNBC, 2025-09-26) is also unquoted.

relationships.title: Nvidia equity in Thinking Machines Lab, tied to a gigawatt Vera Rubin deployment
relationships.insight_template: Nvidia's significant stake in {counterparty} sits beside a gigawatt Vera Rubin deployment plan, so Nvidia funds a customer whose compute it supplies.
relationships.definition: On 10 March 2026 Nvidia and Thinking Machines Lab announced a multiyear partnership to deploy at least one gigawatt of Nvidia Vera Rubin systems, and both said Nvidia had made a significant investment in the lab. Neither release states the amount, price or form.

reconciliation.nvidia_side: Nvidia blog: 'NVIDIA has also made a significant investment in Thinking Machines Lab' and a one gigawatt Vera Rubin plan (ev_30057, ev_30058).
reconciliation.counterparty_side: Thinking Machines' own news page uses the same words on the investment and the one gigawatt plan (ev_90045, ev_90046). Both sides are silent on the amount.

credit.wwr_reason: The stake and the gigawatt deployment both depend on Thinking Machines raising enough capital to pay for compute; equity loss is capped at cost.

first_order.trigger: Thinking Machines cannot fund a full gigawatt
first_order.mechanism: The Vera Rubin deployment shrinks or slips
first_order.text: If Thinking Machines cannot raise enough to pay for a gigawatt of Vera Rubin, Nvidia loses expected sales and the equity value together.

first_order.trigger: Thinking Machines raises at a lower valuation
first_order.mechanism: Nvidia marks down an undisclosed stake
first_order.text: A down round at Thinking Machines would cut the value of a stake Nvidia calls significant but has not sized.

second_order.trigger: Cloud providers build capacity for the Thinking Machines deployment
second_order.mechanism: Their utilization depends on a lab funded partly by Nvidia
second_order.text: Any cloud provider that builds Vera Rubin capacity for Thinking Machines relies on a tenant whose funding Nvidia partly supplies.

second_order.trigger: Thinking Machines spends investment proceeds on Nvidia systems
second_order.mechanism: Nvidia equity returns as hardware revenue
second_order.text: Part of Nvidia's revenue from the Thinking Machines gigawatt would be paid with money Nvidia invested, which lowers the quality of that revenue.

relationships.notes: The Information (2026) reported talks for about $2.5 billion; single tier 2 report, not cached: needs quote. CNBC (2026-03-10) reports Nvidia also joined the July 2025 seed round of about $2 billion; not cached: needs quote.

second_order.text: Reflection names Nvidia among investors in a $2 billion raise without Nvidia's share, so Nvidia's weight in Reflection's funding is unknown.

relationships.title: Nvidia equity in Cohere (repeat participation, 2025 and Series E 2026)
relationships.insight_template: Nvidia keeps adding to an undisclosed stake in {counterparty}, a sovereign AI vendor whose deployments use Nvidia hardware.
relationships.definition: Nvidia is an existing Cohere investor. It took part in Cohere's $500 million round at a $6.8 billion valuation in August 2025 and is named among participants in the initial close of the Series E announced on 29 October 2026, which targets up to CAD 7 billion and is led by Schwarz Group. Nvidia's amounts are not disclosed.

reconciliation.counterparty_side: Cohere names NVIDIA among existing investors in the August 2025 round (ev_90031) and in the Series E initial close (ev_90035).

credit.wwr_reason: Cohere's value depends on enterprise and government AI budgets; Nvidia's exposure is equity only and does not grow if Cohere weakens.

first_order.trigger: Cohere's Series E closes well below its CAD target
first_order.mechanism: Lower valuation and slower spending on compute
first_order.text: If Cohere's Series E falls short of its target, the value of Nvidia's repeated Cohere investments falls and Cohere buys less compute.

first_order.trigger: Cohere's sovereign deployments grow
first_order.mechanism: More Nvidia based systems sold into Cohere projects
first_order.text: Growth in Cohere's sovereign deployments lifts both the Cohere stake and demand for the Nvidia hardware those deployments use.

second_order.trigger: Schwarz Group and Canada fund Cohere alongside Nvidia
second_order.mechanism: Public and strategic money stands next to Nvidia's
second_order.text: The Government of Canada and Schwarz Group invest in Cohere alongside Nvidia, so a Cohere setback would hit public and corporate investors at once.

relationships.notes: Cohere's 2023 Series C page (Nvidia named, per search) did not render text when cached; not quoted. Cohere and Aleph Alpha agreed to combine in April 2026 with Schwarz Group committing about $600 million (EUR 500 million) of structured financing (cached, not recorded as Nvidia related).
